GRADING SYSTEM & EVALUATION: - The college follows a 10-point absolute grading scale: * Grade 'O' (Outstanding): Marks >= 90%, Grade Point = 10 * Grade 'A+' (Excellent): Marks 80-89%, Grade Point = 9 * Grade 'A' (Very Good): Marks 70-79%, Grade Point = 8 * Grade 'B+' (Good): Marks 60-69%, Grade Point = 7 * Grade 'B' (Above Average): Marks 50-59%, Grade Point = 6 * Grade 'C' (Pass): Marks 40-49%, Grade Point = 5

Point = 6 * Grade 'C' (Pass): Marks 40-49%, Grade Point = 5 * Grade 'F' (Fail): Marks < 40%, Grade Point = 0 (Must reappear in supplementary exam) * Grade 'Ab' (Absent): Grade Point = 0 - Semester Grade Point Average (SGPA) = Sum(Credits * Grade Points) / Sum(Credits) for the semester. - Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) = Sum of all grade points across all completed semesters divided by total registered credits.

COLLEGE ADMISSIONS, SCHOLARSHIPS & FEE STRUCTURE 1. FEE SCHEDULE & PAYMENT DEADLINES: - Tuition fees for Odd Semesters (Sem 1, 3, 5, 7): Must be paid on or before August 15th of each academic year. - Tuition fees for Even Semesters (Sem 2, 4, 6, 8): Must be paid on or before January 15th of each academic year. - Late Payment Penalty: * Up to 7 days late: INR 50 per day late fine. * 8 to 20 days late: Flat INR 1,500 penalty.

- Online payments through the student ERP portal via Net Banking, UPI, Credit/Debit cards.
- Demand Draft (DD) in favor of "Principal, Engineering College" payable at campus bank branch.

4. REFUND & CANCELLATION POLICY:
- Cancellation requested before orientation: 100% refund minus INR 1,000 processing charges.
- Cancellation requested within 15 days of semester commencement: 80% tuition fee refund.
- No refund is applicable after 30 days of semester commencement.

3. CAMPUS HEALTH CLINIC & AMBULANCE:
- 24/7 on-campus medical health center with resident medical officer and nursing staff.
- Ambulance service is available round-the-clock for emergencies (Ext: 108 / +91-1234567890).
- Free basic medications and emergency first aid provided to all enrolled students and staff.

4. CAMPUS WI-FI ACCESS:
- High-speed 1 Gbps Wi-Fi is available across all academic blocks, hostels, and library.
- Registration: Connect to "College-Secure", login using Roll Number and College Portal Password. Up to 2 devices per student.

COLLEGE EXAMINATION GUIDELINES & PROCEDURES 1. HALL TICKET & ADMIT CARD: - Digital Hall tickets are issued via the student portal (portal.college.edu) 7 days before examination commencement. - Mandatory requirements to download Hall Ticket: * Minimum 75% attendance confirmed by respective department HOD.

3. REVALUATION & CHALLENGE EVALUATION:
- Students dissatisfied with their evaluation can apply for revaluation within 15 calendar days from the date of result declaration.
- Revaluation fee: INR 500 per subject.
- Challenge valuation is permitted if the student remains dissatisfied after revaluation. Challenge evaluation fee is INR 5,000 per subject (refundable if the grade improves by more than 15%).

4. SUPPLEMENTARY / BACKLOG EXAMINATIONS:
- Supplementary exams for odd semesters are conducted alongside even semester exams, and vice versa.
- Students can register for a maximum of 4 backlog courses per supplementary session.
- Backlog registration fee: INR 350 per course.

COLLEGE TRAINING & PLACEMENT CELL (T&P) GUIDELINES

1. PLACEMENT ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:
- Minimum overall CGPA of 6.5 or above across completed semesters.
- Students must have zero active backlogs at the commencement of campus recruitment drives.
- Minimum 80% attendance in all pre-placement training (PPT) sessions, coding assessments, and soft skills workshops.

2. ONE-STUDENT ONE-OFFER POLICY:
- Once a student secures an offer with a CTC >= INR 6 LPA (Tier-1 Dream Offer), they are considered placed and are only eligible to apply for "Super Dream" companies offering CTC >= INR 12 LPA.
- A student who receives two offers must confirm acceptance of one offer within 48 hours.

3. INTERNSHIPS:
- Summer internships (6 to 8 weeks) after 6th semester are mandatory for all undergraduate students.
- Students securing semester-long internships in 8th semester must obtain an NOC (No Objection Certificate) from the Head of the Department and maintain weekly project progress reports.

4. RESUME & INTERVIEW PREPARATION:
- Standard college format resume verified and signed by faculty coordinator is mandatory for company applications.
- Mock technical interviews and group discussions are conducted every Saturday starting from 5th semester.
- Training modules include Data Structures & Algorithms, System Design, Aptitude, Quantitative Analysis, and Verbal Reasoning.
